description: Shared vectors for the mirrored-message display rule (docs/agent-dm-markers.md §1). Loaded by desktop/src/features/agent-dm/lib/mirrorDisplay.test.mjs and mobile/test/shared/agent_dm/agent_dm_mirror_display_test.dart; both rules must produce exactly these outputs. channel.isDm maps to a DM channel type; channel.memberPubkeys is the DM roster (an empty roster honours nothing); viewer, when present, is the viewing account's pubkey, and an attributed requester who is the viewer reads "You".
